description: Golden physics trace for CONTRACTS.md §4 (racer). Generated from web/src/lib/games/racer/{physics,track}.ts. Schema: `track` is the closed centreline polyline (metres) + halfWidth used for this trace (self-contained; does not depend on web/static/tracks/). `initialCar` is the CarState before tick 0. `ticks` is an ordered array of length >= 600; each entry is `{tick, input: ControlInput, state: CarState, onTrack}` where `state` is the EXACT expected CarState (float64, JSON round-trip exact) after applying the twelve-step update in physics.ts step() to the previous state (or `initialCar` for tick 0) with `input`, using DT=1/60. `onTrack` is isOnTrack(track, state.x, state.y) evaluated on that resulting state. `rayCheckpoints` gives the 7-ray castRays() reading (angles [-1.2,-0.8,-0.4,0,0.4,0.8,1.2] rad relative to heading, normalised distance/50.0, 1.0 = nothing hit within range) at named ticks, alongside the CarState those rays were cast from, so a Python port can validate ray casting independently of the CarState trajectory. A conformance test replays `ticks` tick-by-tick from `initialCar` and asserts the resulting CarState equals `state` at every tick to full float64 precision, and separately recasts rays at each checkpoint and compares against `rays`. Constants (DT, WHEELBASE, MASS, MAX_SPEED, MAX_REVERSE_SPEED, MAX_STEER_ANGLE, ENGINE_FORCE, BRAKE_FORCE, DRAG_COEFF, ROLLING_RESISTANCE, MAX_ANGULAR, RAY_MAX_RANGE) are defined in physics.ts and must be ported with the identical literal values.
